sources.quote: The growth and demand for Gemini 2.5 Pro continues to be the steepest of any of our models we have ever seen. To allow more customers to build on this model in production, we are making the 06-05 version of the model stable, with the same pareto frontier price point as before.
sources.supports: Google stated the stable Gemini 2.5 Pro release retained the preceding price point, but this statement does not give the numerical rates or cache pricing.

sources.quote:
Input price | Free of charge | $1.25, prompts <= 200k tokens  
$2.50, prompts > 200k tokens  
Output price (including thinking tokens) | Free of charge | $10.00, prompts <= 200k tokens  
$15.00, prompts > 200k  
Context caching price | Not available | $0.125, prompts <= 200k tokens  
$0.25, prompts > 200k
sources.supports: Google's archived pricing page displays the later tiered input/output and cache prices; the snapshot postdates the models.dev commit and does not establish when the prices began.

notes: The available primary-source evidence confirms Google's stable release kept the earlier price point and shows the later official tiered rates, but it does not establish whether models.dev's earlier flat rates and $0.31 cache_read were once official or an omission/error. Internet Archive CDX retrieval for the historical pricing page did not return usable results, so no effective date or prior official cache rate can be determined.
